promptInjection.addDialogDescription.en: Use a shared API connection for prompt injection checks.
promptInjection.addDialogDescription.zh-CN: 使用共享 API 连接进行提示词注入检查。

promptInjection.description.en: Check tool results for instructions that could redirect your agents. The selected provider receives tool content and charges API usage. Built-in detection is used when the model is unavailable.
promptInjection.description.zh-CN: 检查工具返回结果中是否包含可能诱导或劫持智能体的指令。所选提供方将接收工具内容并按 API 用量计费。当模型不可用时，将使用内置检测。

promptInjection.enableModelChecks.en: Use model for prompt injection checks
promptInjection.enableModelChecks.zh-CN: 使用模型进行提示词注入检查

promptInjection.loadError.en: Could not load prompt injection settings.
promptInjection.loadError.zh-CN: 无法加载提示词注入防护设置。

promptInjection.loading.zh-CN: 正在加载提示词注入防护设置…

promptInjection.modelsError.en: Could not load model suggestions. You can still enter and save a model ID.
promptInjection.modelsError.zh-CN: 无法加载模型推荐列表，你仍可手动输入并保存模型 ID。

promptInjection.noConnections.en: Add a shared OpenRouter API connection to use model checks.
promptInjection.noConnections.zh-CN: 添加共享 OpenRouter API 连接以启用模型检查。

promptInjection.sampleFallback.en: Model unavailable ({{reason}}); built-in detection is the fallback.
promptInjection.sampleFallback.zh-CN: 模型不可用（{{reason}}）；已回退为内置检测。

promptInjection.saveBeforeTesting.zh-CN: 请先保存更改再进行测试。

promptInjection.saveButton.zh-CN: 保存提示词注入防护设置

promptInjection.testChargeNote.en: Tests two fixed samples with an API charge.
promptInjection.testChargeNote.zh-CN: 将使用两个固定样本进行测试并产生 API 费用。

promptInjection.testFailed.en: Model checks did not pass. Check the connection and model, then try again.
promptInjection.testFailed.zh-CN: 模型检查未通过。请检查连接与模型后重试。

promptInjection.testPassed.zh-CN: 两项模型检查均已通过。

promptInjection.unavailableConnection.en: The saved connection is unavailable. Choose a replacement, disable model checks, or clear the selection. Built-in detection stays active.
promptInjection.unavailableConnection.zh-CN: 已保存的连接当前不可用。请选择替代连接、禁用模型检查或清除选择。内置检测将继续保持启用。
